name: Sludir
description: The Sludir were reptilian sapients indigenous to Sluudren. They were large, imposing people, with two arms, six legs, and a thick armored carapace. For millennia, they lived without advanced technology in a society ruled by the proud members of a warrior caste. This changed once Sluudren was discovered by offworlders, as their homeworld was conquered by the Galactic Empire, and the Sludir were enslaved.
